style: Authentic documentary-style photograph, shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens, soft natural daylight, realistic skin and materials, shallow depth of field, warm and clean colours, uncluttered composition with the subject centred, square 1:1 framing. No text, no letters, no watermarks, no logos, no brand names anywhere in the image.
